lines.beaver: 민지 씨, 내일 어떤 옷을 입을 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, what are you going to wear tomorrow?
lines.beaver_roman: Minji ssi, naeil eotteon oseul ibeul geoyeyo?
lines.en: I'm going to wear a T-shirt and pants.

lines.beaver_en: Why do you want to wear that?
lines.en: We're going to walk a lot in the park tomorrow.

lines.beaver: 아, 그렇죠. 치마는 안 입을 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: Ah, right. You won't wear a skirt?
lines.beaver_roman: A, geureochyo. Chimaneun an ibeul geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 치마는 안 입을 거예요. 바지가 편해요.
lines.en: No, I won't wear a skirt. Pants are comfortable.
lines.roman: Ne, chimaneun an ibeul geoyeyo. Bajiga pyeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What shoes are you going to wear?
lines.en: I'll wear sneakers. Dress shoes are uncomfortable.
What color T-shirt will you wear?

lines.beaver_en: Great! The sun will be strong tomorrow.

lines.learner: 신발하고 모자를 오늘 미리 준비할 거예요.
lines.en: I'll get my shoes and hat ready today.
lines.roman: Sinbalhago mojareul oneul miri junbihal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What time are we meeting tomorrow?
lines.learner: 열 시에 공원 앞에서 만날 거예요.
lines.en: We'll meet at ten in front of the park.
lines.roman: Yeol sie gongwon apeseo mannal geoyeyo.

lines.en: Yes, see you tomorrow! Good night.
